description:
Automatically records your work to a secure private timeline.

Memory is Timely's tool that automatically records everything you do to your own, private timeline. It captures the time you actively spend in files, on apps, browsing websites, your calendar events, attending meetings, and more - the sky's the limit! By capturing everything you do, you get a complete picture of what you work on each day.
- Redesigned Away time and Schedule settings.
- Away time: choose when Memory keeps capturing without input (on a call, in fullscreen, or in apps you pick), the longest absence to ask about, and when to ask.
- Away time: the return prompt shows each absence in order, including time away recorded while the prompt was open. Messages you've typed recently appear as suggestions.
- Fix: brief upload problems no longer show an error.
- [windows] Fix: fixed the main window not opening from the tray or taskbar after using the settings button in the away prompt. Clicking the tray icon now also brings back a minimized window.
- [mac] Fix: automated mouse and keyboard events, for example from an AI agent, no longer end an absence.
